title: Primitive authority registry
root_cause: Canonical primitives exist across modules but their authority and bypass boundaries are not declared in one machine-readable registry.
source_requirement: Declare one canonical owner for every required primitive without forcing a monolithic implementation.
implementation_steps: Map all thirteen required primitive classes to current or planned owners.
Reject missing owners, duplicate owners, and undeclared bypasses.
affected_tests: Generated artifact and registry integrity tests.
evidence_required: Validated registry and owner-symbol resolution receipt.
rollback: Remove the new registry/loader and restore consumers to their previous explicit owners.
acceptance_criteria: Every required primitive resolves to exactly one canonical owner.
